ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the figure: In the figure there is a large triangle ACE, point B is on side AC, point F is on side AE, and point D is on the base CE. The arrow marks in the figure show that BF is parallel to CD/CE in the direction of the base, and CB is parallel to DF, so quadrilateral CBFD is a parallelogram. Thus BF = CD = y, and DF = BC = x. Then reason: It is given that AB=6, AF=8, BC=x, CD=y, DE=2y-3, FE=x+10/3. By adding line segments, AC=AB+BC=6+x, AE=AF+FE=8+x+10/3=x+34/3, CE=CD+DE=y+(2y-3)=3y-3. method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a large triangle ACE with B on AC, D on CE, and F on AE. The arrow markings show BF is parallel to CD/CE and CB is parallel to DF, so CBFD is a parallelogram; hence BF = CD = y and DF = BC = x. From the text use AB=6, AF=8, BC=x, CD=y, DE=2y-3, FE=x+10/3. Compute AC=AB+BC=x+6, AE=AF+FE=x+34/3, and CE=CD+DE=3y-3. Since BF is parallel to CE, triangles ABF and ACE are similar, so set AB/AC = AF/AE to solve for x, then use BF/CE = AB/AC, i.e. y/(3y-3)=6/(x+6), to solve for y=CD.

先描述图像：图中是一个大三角形 ACE，点 B 在边 AC 上，点 F 在边 AE 上，点 D 在底边 CE 上。图中的箭头标记显示 BF 与底边方向的 CD/CE 平行，且 CB 与 DF 平行，因此四边形 CBFD 是平行四边形。于是 BF = CD = y，DF = BC = x。

再推理：已知 AB=6，AF=8，BC=x，CD=y，DE=2y-3，FE=x+10/3。由线段相加得 AC=AB+BC=6+x，AE=AF+FE=8+x+10/3=x+34/3，CE=CD+DE=y+(2y-3)=3y-3。因为 BF ∥ CE，所以三角形 ABF 与三角形 ACE 相似。由相似比 AB/AC = AF/AE，得到 6/(x+6)=8/(x+34/3)。交叉相乘：6(x+34/3)=8(x+6)，即 6x+68=8x+48，所以 x=10。再用相似比 BF/CE = AB/AC，即 y/(3y-3)=6/(10+6)=6/16=3/8。交叉相乘得 8y=3(3y-3)=9y-9，所以 y=9。因为 CD=y，所以 CD=9。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as triangle ACE with D on CE and F on AE, and note from the arrows that DF is parallel to AC and BF is parallel to CE, making CBFD a parallelogram. Therefore DF=BC=x and CE=CD+DE=y+(2y-3)=3y-3. Also AE=AF+FE=8+(x+10/3)=x+34/3 and AC=AB+BC=x+6. Instead of using triangle ABF, use the lower-right triangle DFE: because DF ∥ AC, triangles DFE and CAE are similar. Set DF/AC = FE/AE, i.e. x/(x+6) = (x+10/3)/(x+34/3), to solve x. method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个大三角形 ACE，A 在上方，C 在左下方，E 在右下方。点 B 在边 AC 上，点 F 在边 AE 上，点 D 在底边 CE 上。图中箭头标记显示 BF 与底边 CE 平行，DF 与边 AC 平行，因此四边形 CBFD 是平行四边形。

推理：由 CBFD 是平行四边形，得到 DF = BC = x。大三角形中，AC = AB + BC = 6 + x；AE = AF + FE = 8 + (x + 10/3) = x + 34/3；CE = CD + DE = y + (2y - 3) = 3y - 3。

按照指定方法，使用右下方三角形 DFE 与大三角形 CAE。因为 DF ∥ AC，且 FE 在 AE 上，DE 在 CE 上，所以 △DFE ∼ △CAE。于是
DF/AC = FE/AE，
即 x/(x+6) = (x+10/3)/(x+34/3)。
交叉相乘：
x(x+34/3) = (x+6)(x+10/3)。
展开得 x^2 + 34x/3 = x^2 + 28x/3 + 20，所以 6x/3 = 20，即 2x = 20，x = 10。

相似比为 x/(x+6) = 10/16 = 5/8。再用 DE/CE = DF/AC：
(2y-3)/(3y-3) = 5/8。
交叉相乘：8(2y-3)=5(3y-3)，即 16y-24=15y-15，所以 y=9。
因此 CD = y = 9。
